document.abstract: The properties of various developers, including a two-bath hardening developer suitable for the rapid processing of negatives, are described. In the case of still photography, considerable time can be saved by printing from the wet negatives. Several methods are described for holding the negative to prevent damage to the wet emulsion by the heat of the printer light.
